signatures.name: ev_sensitivity
signatures.description: Higher expected-value difference (risky_EV - safe_value) predicts a higher probability of choosing the risky option. The headline EV-tracking signature.

signatures.name: above_chance_ev_optimal
signatures.description: On trials with a clearly higher-EV option, the agent picks it above chance (0.5). A weaker EV-tracking signal that isolates direction without requiring a parametric trend.

signatures.name: magnitude_effect_high_payoff
signatures.description: When the risky payoff is large (gamble_value=50), agents choose risky more often than when the payoff is small (gamble_value=8) at matched probability levels. Tests sensitivity to payoff magnitude.

signatures.name: ev_difference_rt_effect
signatures.description: Response time falls as the expected-value difference between options grows: easier choices are decided faster. A basic property of value-based choice (Krajbich et al. 2010) and a within-task ordering, so it is unaffected by the constant offset between agent inference latency and human RT.
